changes: command_adapters/contracts.py: one _WRAPPER_VERB_ALIASES table and canonicalize_wrapped_payload; submit_command_admission rewrites a mapped wrapper payload to its canonical command before any other step, so hash, confirm-token binding, approval/two-man, validators, target checks, storage and execution see only the canonical command

the mapping table (_WRAPPER_CANONICALS -> _WRAPPER_VERB_ALIASES) holds every alias the adapters accepted before (short verbs plus the canonical command names, e.g. RuntimeAction/pausepaperruntime, PersonaAction/advance_lifecycle, DeploymentAction/approvedeployment); Evolution program verbs have no canonical CommandType so they are not mapped and keep the EvolutionCommandAdapter owner path; no global *Action fallback

deleted adapter branches/handlers unreachable after the rewrite (deployment approve, capital approve-pool/rebalance-apply, persona EmergencyContainment, wrapper verb aliases in runtime/capital/deployment/incident/persona) and default credentials (sig-emergency-ops, lifecycle-confirm, sig-sentinel-remed)

assistant governed tools submit through the one CommandAdapterService resolved before both routers mount (app_factory), and the receipt carries the stored command id from the admission response; empty admission output is rejected

review round 2: table now also maps every other adapter-accepted canonical alias (RuntimeAction repair/safe-mode/risk-off/approve+reject rollback, PersonaAction observe/demote, DeploymentAction create/patch, RebalanceAction propose/create); admission-stored StartRuntime/AdvanceLifecycle records resolve trusted runtime_id and the admitted confirm_token id at execution (no default credential); dead action_id branches in runtime/persona adapters and the persona AdvanceLifecycle adapter handler removed

tests.added: tests/test_command_adapters_router.py::test_wrapped_alias_is_admitted_exactly_like_its_canonical_command (table-driven over the single mapping table; per alias: own-token, token issued for another action, no-token; seeded approval and two-man evidence; compares response, persisted type/params/status and request_hash), test_every_alias_has_an_accepted_path_stored_as_canonical (202 and persisted type == canonical for every alias), test_unmapped_wrapper_combinations_are_not_rewritten, test_unmapped_wrapper_is_rejected_before_storage, test_assistant_admission_uses_injected_service_and_returns_stored_command_id; test_accepted_wrapped_alias_dispatches_successfully (StartRuntime, AdvanceLifecycle execute successfully with mocked owner backend)
tests.updated: test_aud_002 (unmapped verb), test_assistant_security (admission stub), test_management_domain_actions (removed 3 wrapper-via-adapter tests for now-unreachable paths)
tests.result: scoped batch: 276 passed, 3 failed; the 3 failures are pre-existing and untouched by this change: test_zero_reverse_main_imports, test_command_confirmations_lifecycle, test_confirm_command_by_token_contract_and_regressions

known_limits: Response/stored command for a wrapped submission now reports the canonical command name. Order-dependent baseline pollution between test_management_domain_actions and test_evolution_program_owner_contract exists on dev.
